highlights.title: A Goldman M&A Banker Helped Bring the Olympics to Los Angeles
highlights.description: We're in an era of megadeals, with Goldman Sachs reporting a record year for big deal volumes as companies scramble to compete with AI. Gene Sykes has seen multiple deal cycles come and go over his multi-decade career at the firm. The co-head of mergers and acquisitions has worked on famous transactions like Comcast's purchase of Universal and Disney's buyout of Pixar. highlights.title: China State TV Affiliate Flags Anthropic Data and Privacy Risks
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC’s privacy-policy revisions have increased risks to user data by allowing information to be shared with US intelligence agencies when the company considers it necessary without legal procedures, a social-media account affiliated with China Central Television said in a post on Saturday.

highlights.title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
highlights.description: Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor project has run into an unexpected trademark dispute with Tera-print, a small U.S. company that has used the Tera-Fab name for its tabletop lithography equipment for about a decade.

highlights.title: California Court Blocks Part of TikTok’s $400 Million Settlement
highlights.description: A Los Angeles judge tentatively opposed part of the US government’s agreement with TikTok to resolve allegations of children’s privacy violations, extending uncertainty around the service’s operations in the country.

highlights.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max’s battery is so big Apple had to add this new feature to iOS 27
highlights.description: The iPhone 18 Pro Max offers a huge jump in battery life, partly because the battery itself is physically larger. In a new support document published today, Apple says the iPhone 18 Pro Max has such a big battery that it has additional shipping requirements. more…

highlights.title: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
highlights.description: Intel’s bug bounty program on Intigriti now shows as suspended, and a new Intel disclosure program there pays no bounties.

highlights.title: Xiaomi Has a Luxury SUV for $31,000 That All Western Brands Should Fear
highlights.description: The SkyNomad—with heated floors, a projector, a pop-up roof, a fridge, swiveling seats, and over 1,000 miles of range—is a “luxury” ride that undercuts Range Rovers by tens of thousands of dollars.

highlights.title: Apple Exec Says 'Hold Us Accountable' on iPhone Duo Crease
highlights.description: Apple hardware engineering VP Tom Marieb spoke with TechRadar and shared some candid thoughts about Apple's upcoming iPhone Duo. highlights.title: Enthusiast digs into CPU substrate to replace ripped-off data pin — resurrected chip boots and hits 33% overclock
highlights.description: An Intel Celeron 1200 (Tualatin) was revived from the dead after a ripped-off pin was successfully replaced.

highlights.title: A new arms race is unfolding on the ocean floor
highlights.description: Countries and companies are investing in technologies for underwater use amid concerns about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure on the ocean floor.
